additional_info.subject: ID0416103-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001826]Outlet1:error,LEMState: Working CRM:02681000040
additional_info.body:
Hi Chloë,
Thanks for the feedback. These “unavailable” messages that you are seeing are from 2 points:
I deactivated the outlets on purpose in case some customer wanted to charge and suddenly the hotfix was started, could lead to problems, we always do it this way to avoid issue.
When the hotfix is being performed, it turns from available to unavailable and vice-versa some times, because that's just how it works.
I hope this answered to your needs, I already closed the ticket so if you need any assistance please raise another ticket refering this one 0416103. You can also refer my name if necessary.
Thank you and have anice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
